evals.prompt: What is the difference between payment-first and service-first subscription mode in Waffo?
evals.expected_output: Should explain BOTH axes: (1) billing cycle & dunning — payment-first resets the billing cycle to the actual payment date and stops charging the next period once retries are exhausted, while service-first keeps the original billing anchor and still charges the next period after retries are exhausted; (2) benefits during retry — payment-first suspends benefits during the retry window, service-first keeps benefits. Should not explain only one axis.

assertions.name: covers_billing_cycle_axis
assertions.check: Explains the billing-cycle/dunning axis: payment-first resets the cycle to the payment date and does not charge the next period after retries are exhausted; service-first keeps the anchor and still charges

assertions.name: covers_benefit_axis
assertions.check: Explains the benefit axis: payment-first suspends benefits during retry; service-first keeps benefits during retry

assertions.name: does_not_explain_only_one_axis
assertions.check: Does NOT describe the modes using only the benefit axis (or only the billing axis) without the other

evals.expected_output: Should state that retry count and interval are a Waffo-side subscription contract configuration (developer-reference default: 2 attempts including the first, once per day; interval configurable), NOT something set in integration code. Should tell the developer to confirm the actual contract config with Waffo and must NOT generate code that hardcodes retry count/interval or retry scheduling.

assertions.name: retry_is_waffo_contract_config
assertions.check: States retry count/interval is a Waffo-side subscription contract config, not decided by integration code, and to confirm the actual value with Waffo

assertions.name: does_not_hardcode_retry
